                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • ਲਾਈਟ ਉਦਯੋਗਾਂ ਦੇ ਮੁੱਖ ਕਾਰਜ:\n\n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            \n\t\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • ਲਾਈਟ ਉਦਯੋਗ ਰੋਜ਼ਾਨਾ ਦੇ ਉਤਪਾਦਾਂ ਦੀ ਸਪਲਾਈ ਕਰਕੇ ਖਪਤਕਾਰਾਂ ਦੀਆਂ ਮੁੱਢਲੀਆਂ ਲੋੜਾਂ ਪੂਰੀਆਂ ਕਰਨ ਲਈ ਜ਼ਰੂਰੀ ਹਨ।
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • \n\t\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • ਉਹ ਨਿਰਯਾਤ-ਮੁਖੀ ਅਰਥਵਿਵਸਥਾਵਾਂ ਵਿੱਚ ਮੁੱਖ ਭੂਮਿਕਾ ਨਿਭਾਉਂਦੇ ਹਨ, ਜਿੱਥੇ ਅੰਤਰਰਾਸ਼ਟਰੀ ਬਾਜ਼ਾਰਾਂ ਲਈ ਖਪਤਕਾਰ ਵਸਤੂਆਂ ਦਾ ਨਿਰਮਾਣ ਕੀਤਾ ਜਾਂਦਾ ਹੈ।
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • ਲਾਈਟ ਉਦਯੋਗਾਂ ਦੀਆਂ ਗਲੋਬਲ ਉਦਾਹਰਨਾਂ:\n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            \n\t\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • ਚੀਨ: ਖਪਤਕਾਰ ਇਲੈਕਟ੍ਰੋਨਿਕਸ ਅਤੇ ਟੈਕਸਟਾਈਲ ਦੇ ਵੱਡੇ ਪੱਧਰ 'ਤੇ ਉਤਪਾਦਨ ਲਈ ਜਾਣਿਆ ਜਾਂਦਾ ਹੈ, ਜੋ ਗਲੋਬਲ ਬਾਜ਼ਾਰਾਂ 'ਤੇ ਹਾਵੀ ਹਨ।
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • \n\t\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • ਭਾਰਤ: ਗਾਰਮੈਂਟ ਨਿਰਮਾਣ ਅਤੇ ਫੂਡ ਪ੍ਰੋਸੈਸਿੰਗ ਵਰਗੇ ਵਧ ਰਹੇ ਲਾਈਟ ਉਦਯੋਗਾਂ ਦਾ ਘਰ, ਜੋ ਇਸਦੇ ਜੀਡੀਪੀ ਵਿੱਚ ਮਹੱਤਵਪੂਰਨ ਯੋਗਦਾਨ ਪਾਉਂਦੇ ਹਨ।
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • \n\t\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • ਸੰਯੁਕਤ ਰਾਜ: ਬ੍ਰਾਂਡਡ ਇਲੈਕਟ੍ਰੋਨਿਕਸ ਅਤੇ ਪੈਕ ਕੀਤੇ ਭੋਜਨ ਵਰਗੀਆਂ ਉੱਚ-ਸ਼੍ਰੇਣੀ ਦੀਆਂ ਖਪਤਕਾਰ ਵਸਤੂਆਂ 'ਤੇ ਕੇਂਦਰਿਤ ਹੈ।
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • \n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n1b5:T1c82,\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        The correct answer is London and New York.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        Key Points

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n\n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • The Global Cities Index, published by Oxford Economics, ranks cities based on various parameters such as economic strength, innovation, infrastructure, culture, and quality of life.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • London and New York frequently top such rankings due to their global influence, robust economies, and cultural significance.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • London is renowned for being a leading financial hub, housing institutions like the London Stock Exchange and significant cultural landmarks, making it a prominent choice in global rankings.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • New York City, similarly, is an economic powerhouse, hosting the New York Stock Exchange (NYSE) and being a center for media, arts, and innovation.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • These cities consistently rank at the top due to their diverse populations, advanced infrastructure, and strategic global connectivity.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • The Global Cities Index evaluates over 100 cities worldwide, measuring their impact on global affairs through contributions to economic activity, political engagement, and social development.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • London and New York are viewed as benchmarks for urban development, offering insights into how cities can thrive in the 21st century.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • Hence, the correct answer is London and New York.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • \n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        Additional Information

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n\n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • Global Cities Index:\n\n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            \n\t\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • The Global Cities Index by Oxford Economics evaluates cities based on their ability to attract and retain talent, businesses, and investors.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • \n\t\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • Factors considered include economic output, innovation, cultural diversity, political engagement, and livability.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • \n\t\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • The index reflects how cities contribute to the global economy and their roles in shaping international trends.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • Characteristics of Top Cities:\n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            \n\t\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • London: Known for its finance, arts, and historical heritage, London is home to globally renowned institutions and a diverse population.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • \n\t\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • New York City: Often called the "capital of the world", NYC is a leader in finance, entertainment, technology, and culture.

"ਚੋਣ ਪ੍ਰਕਿਰਿਆਵਾਂ"}, {"prompt": "3", "value": "ਐਮਰਜੈਂਸੀ ਪ੍ਰਬੰਧ"}, {"prompt": "4", "value": "ਨਿਆਂਇਕ ਢਾਂਚਾ"}], "range": {"start": "", "end": ""}}}, "correct_option": "1", "solution_html": {"en": "\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            The correct answer is Three legislative lists.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            Key Points

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            \n\n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • Schedule VII of the Indian Constitution categorically deals with the division of powers between the Union and the State Governments.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • It contains the Three legislative lists, namely the Union List, the State List, and the Concurrent List. These lists specify the subjects on which respective governments can legislate.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • Union List: This list includes subjects on which only the Parliament can make laws. Examples include defense, foreign affairs, atomic energy, and banking.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • State List: This list includes subjects on which only the State Legislatures can make laws. Examples include police, public health, agriculture, and local government.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • Concurrent List: This list includes subjects on which both the Parliament and the State Legislatures can legislate. Examples include education, marriage, bankruptcy, and trade unions.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • The division of legislative powers ensures a federal structure by defining the areas of governance for both levels of government.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • Hence, Schedule VII of the Indian Constitution contains the Three legislative lists.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • \n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            Additional Information

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            \n\n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • Union List:\n\n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                \n\t\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • The Union List currently has 97 subjects. The Union Government has exclusive power to legislate on these subjects.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                • \n\t\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • Some important subjects in the Union List include defense, foreign affairs, currency, railways, and citizenship.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • State List:\n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                \n\t\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • The State List includes 61 subjects. The State Legislatures have exclusive power to legislate on these subjects unless the Constitution provides otherwise.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                • \n\t\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • Subjects like land, agriculture, police, and local government are included in the State List.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • Concurrent List:\n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                \n\t\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • The Concurrent List consists of 52 subjects. Both the Union and State Governments can legislate on these subjects.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                • \n\t\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • In case of conflict, the law enacted by the Union Government prevails over the State law.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                • \n\t\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • Subjects like education, trade unions, and criminal law fall under the Concurrent List.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • Importance of Schedule VII:\n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                \n\t\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • Schedule VII is crucial for maintaining the federal structure of India by clearly defining the legislative areas of the Union and State Governments.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                • \n\t\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • It reduces the chances of overlapping legislation and ensures administrative efficiency.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • \n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            Important Points

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            \n\n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • Historical Background:\n\n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                \n\t\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • The Government of India Act, 1935 served as the foundation for the legislative division in Schedule VII.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                • \n\t\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • The act introduced the concept of federalism by categorizing subjects into lists, which was later adopted in the Constitution of India.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • Amendments:\n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                \n\t\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • The 42nd Amendment Act, 1976 added subjects like education and forests to the Concurrent List.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                • \n\t\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • Certain subjects have been moved between lists based on socio-economic and political requirements.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              \n\t
