                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          ⇒ sin A = 12/13 (કારણ કે A લઘુકોણ છે, sin A ધનાત્મક છે)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          જવાબ: sin A = 12/13

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n", "kn": "

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          ನೀಡಲಾಗಿದೆ:

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          sec A = 13/5 ಮತ್ತು A ಲಘು ಕೋನವಾಗಿದೆ.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          ಬಳಸಿದ ಸೂತ್ರ:

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          sec A = 1/cos A

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          sin²A + cos²A = 1

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          ಲೆಕ್ಕಾಚಾರಗಳು:

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          ⇒ cos A = 5/13

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          ⇒ sin²A = 1 − (5/13)² = 1 − 25/169 = 144/169

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          ಉತ್ತರ: sin A = 12/13

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n", "ta": "

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          sec A = 13/5 மற்றும் A ஒரு குறுங்கோணம்.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          பயன்படுத்தப்பட்ட சூத்திரம்:

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          ⇒ sin A = 12/13 (A ஒரு குறுங்கோணம் என்பதால், sin A நேர்மறையானது)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          விடை: sin A = 12/13

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n", "or": "

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          sec A = 13/5 ଏବଂ A ଏକ ସୂକ୍ଷ୍ମ କୋଣ ଅଟେ |

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          ବ୍ୟବହୃତ ସୂତ୍ର:

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          sin²A + cos²A = 1

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          ଗଣନା:

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          ⇒ cos A = 5/13

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          ଉତ୍ତର: sin A = 12/13

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          ਗਣਨਾਵਾਂ:

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          Select the most appropriate synonym of the given word:

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          Relinquish.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n", "options": [{"prompt": "1", "value": "Demean"}, {"prompt": "2", "value": "Accept"}, {"prompt": "3", "value": "Abdicate"}, {"prompt": "4", "value": "Apply"}], "range": {"start": "", "end": ""}}}, "correct_option": "3", "solution_html": {"en": "\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          The correct answer is: Option 3 (Abdicate).

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          Key Points

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n\n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • The word "Relinquish" means to voluntarily give up or let go of something, such as a right, possession, or claim. (त्यागना, छोड़ देना)\n\n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              \n\t\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • Example: She decided to relinquish her leadership position to focus on her family.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • "Abdicate" means to formally give up a position of power or responsibility, especially a throne or high office. (सिंहासन छोड़ना)\n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              \n\t\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • Example: The king chose to abdicate the throne in favor of his son.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • Both words share the meaning of giving up something, but "abdicate" is more specific to positions of authority or power.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • \n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          Therefore, the correct answer is: Option 3 (Abdicate).

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          Additional Information

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n\n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • Demean (अपमानित करना): To lower someone’s dignity or self-respect.\n\n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              \n\t\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • Example: He didn’t mean to demean her, but his words came across as rude.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • Accept (स्वीकार करना): To agree to receive or take something.\n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              \n\t\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • Example: She was happy to accept the job offer after the interview.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • Apply (आवेदन करना): To make a formal request or to put something into operation.\n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              \n\t\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • Example: You should apply for the scholarship if you meet the eligibility criteria.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • \n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n\n34:Tc20,\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          The correct answer is: Option 2.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          Move heaven and earth

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n", "options": [{"prompt": "1", "value": "To move slowly"}, {"prompt": "2", "value": "To work continuously"}, {"prompt": "3", "value": "To command"}, {"prompt": "4", "value": "To follow"}], "range": {"start": "", "end": ""}}}, "correct_option": "2", "solution_html": {"en": "\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          The correct answer is: Option 2.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          Key Points

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n\n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • The idiom "Move heaven and earth" means to make every possible effort to achieve something or to overcome challenges. (हर संभव प्रयास करना)\n\n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              \n\t\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • Example: He moved heaven and earth to get the project completed on time.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • The correct meaning of the idiom here is "To work continuously", which refers to putting in tireless effort to accomplish a task. (लगातार काम करना)\n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              \n\t\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • Example: She worked continuously day and night to prepare for the exams.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            \n\t

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • Option 3: To command (आदेश देना): Refers to giving instructions or orders to someone.\n\t

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          Key Points
