                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • The word "Authoritative" refers to something or someone having authority, being commanding, reliable, or confident. It implies possession of power or influence. (प्रामाणिक, अधिकारपूर्ण)\n\n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              \n\t\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • Example: The teacher has an authoritative tone that demands respect from the students.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • "Weak" is the opposite of authoritative, referring to someone or something lacking strength, power, or influence. (कमज़ोर)\n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              \n\t\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • Example: His arguments were weak and failed to convince the audience.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • Hence, the antonym of 'Authoritative' is 'Weak'.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • \n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          Therefore, the correct answer is: Weak.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • Option 2: "on which" is incorrect as it refers to a specific date or day, which is not the intended meaning.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • Option 4: "whereupon" is incorrect because it implies an immediate result rather than a time reference.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          Select the correct option:

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          Only a transformative change has the power to ________ the deep-rooted bureaucratic stagnation.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n", "options": [{"prompt": "1", "value": "pervasive"}, {"prompt": "2", "value": "dislodge"}, {"prompt": "3", "value": "persuasion"}, {"prompt": "4", "value": "inculcate"}], "range": {"start": "", "end": ""}}}, "correct_option": "2", "solution_html": {"en": "\n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          The correct answer is 'dislodge'.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n\n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                           
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n\n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          Key Points
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n\n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • The word "dislodge" means to remove or force out of a position or place. (हटाना)
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • The sentence suggests that only a transformative change can remove or unsettle the deep-rooted bureaucratic stagnation effectively.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • The other options: "pervasive," "persuasion," and "inculcate" do not fit the context appropriately.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • \n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          ​Therefore, the correct answer is 'Option 2'.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          Complete Sentence: Only a transformative change has the power to dislodge the deep-rooted bureaucratic stagnation.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n\n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          Additional Information
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n\n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • Pervasive (व्यापक): means spreading widely throughout an area or group.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • Persuasion (प्रेरणा): means the act of convincing someone to believe or do something.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • Inculcate (मन में बैठाना): means instilling an idea, attitude, or habit through repeated instruction.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • \n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          The correct answer is Option 3.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n\n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                           
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n\n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          Key Points
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n\n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • The error lies in subject–verb agreement.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • The subject of the sentence is "Many instances", which is plural.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • A plural subject must take a plural verb, but the verb used is "is", which is singular.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • Therefore, "is" should be replaced with "are."
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • \n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n\n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          Therefore, the correct answer is Option 3.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n\n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                           
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n\n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          Correct Sentence: "Many instances that seem like cooperation between government regulator and private sector are, in truth, merely accidental interactions arising from divergent responsibilities."
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n\n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                           
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n\n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          Additional Information
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n\n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • Option 1: Grammatically correct phrase; no error.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • Option 2: Usage of plural noun "private sectors" is acceptable in this context.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • Option 4: Prepositional phrase is grammatically correct.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n\n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          Key Points
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n\n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • The primary issue in the sentence lies in part 4. The verb "adheres" is incorrectly used and does not align with the subject "every ancillary apparatus."
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • The subject "every ancillary apparatus" is singular, and the verb should be in its base form ("adhere") to match the modal verb "will."
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • Modal verbs like "will" are followed by the base form of the verb without any suffix ("s" or "es").
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • Thus, the error is located in part 4 of the sentence.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • \n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n\n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          Therefore, the correct answer is Option 4.
