                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n\n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                           
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n\n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          Key Points
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n\n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • Passive voice structure: The object of the active voice sentence becomes the subject of the passive voice sentence.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • In the active voice, the sentence is: "Researchers can seldom obtain classified laboratory data without approval."
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • To convert to passive voice: Place the object "classified laboratory data" at the beginning.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • Change the active verb form "can obtain" to "can be obtained" (modal verb passive).
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • Ensure the adverb "seldom" remains in the sentence for clarity.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • \n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n\n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          Therefore, the correct answer is Option 3.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n\n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                           
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n\n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          Additional Information
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n\n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • Option 1: "Classified laboratory data can seldom being obtained without approval." – Incorrect usage of "being."
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • Option 2: "Classified laboratory data could seldom be obtained without approval." – Incorrect modal verb "could" instead of "can."
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • Option 4: "Classified laboratory data are seldom able to be obtained without approval." – Incorrect phrasing "are seldom able to be obtained."
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • \n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          Select the sentence containing the homonym of the highlighted word:

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          The king's gules hegemonised the family coat of arms.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n", "options": [{"prompt": "1", "value": "The exorbitant hall featured gules and argent prominently."}, {"prompt": "2", "value": "The cook prepared a sauce of deep gules and cumin."}, {"prompt": "3", "value": "The gules border symbolised martial lineage."}, {"prompt": "4", "value": "The hermit explained the symbolism of gules to the followers."}], "range": {"start": "", "end": ""}}}, "correct_option": "2", "solution_html": {"en": "\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          The correct answer is: Option 2 i.e. The cook prepared a sauce of deep gules and cumin.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          Key Points

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n\n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • The word “gules” in heraldry means the color red, especially a deep red color used on coats of arms. (लाल रंग)\n\n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              \n\t\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • Example: The family crest displayed a lion on a field of gules, representing bravery and valor.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • In the correct option, “gules” is used as a homonym referring to “gul” (a word that sounds similar but is unrelated in meaning). It humorously implies a deep red sauce, showing the use of “gules” as a color reference outside heraldry. (सॉस का लाल रंग)\n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              \n\t\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • Example: The chef added paprika to give the dish a gules hue that made it look appetizing.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • Hence, the sentence that contains the homonymic use of the word “gules” is Option 2.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • \n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          Therefore, the correct answer is: The cook prepared a sauce of deep gules and cumin.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          Additional Information

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n\n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • Option 1: “The exorbitant hall featured gules and argent prominently.” – Correctly uses “gules” in the heraldic sense (लाल रंग), not as a homonym.\n\n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              \n\t\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • Example: The knight’s banner was divided into gules and argent.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • Option 3: “The gules border symbolised martial lineage.” – Again, “gules” is used in its original heraldic sense, meaning red (लाल रंग).\n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              \n\t\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • Example: The shield with a gules border denoted courage.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • Option 4: “The hermit explained the symbolism of gules to the followers.” – Refers to heraldic symbolism (लाल रंग का प्रतीक), not a homonym.\n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              \n\t\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • Example: The hermit taught that gules symbolises bravery and sacrifice.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • \n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n\n3e:T70c,\n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          The correct answer is Convert the sentence provided below from its passive voice structure to an active voice structure:

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          Lunch is delivered to the office every morning.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n", "options": [{"prompt": "1", "value": "The office delivers the lunch every morning."}, {"prompt": "2", "value": "Someone delivers the lunch to the office every morning."}, {"prompt": "3", "value": "The office has delivered the lunch every morning."}, {"prompt": "4", "value": "The lunch delivers itself to the office every morning."}], "range": {"start": "", "end": ""}}}, "correct_option": "2", "solution_html": {"en": "\n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          The correct answer is Option 2.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n\n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                           
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n\n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          Key Points
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n\n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • Passive voice structure: The object of the active voice sentence becomes the subject of the passive voice sentence.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • In the passive sentence provided: "Lunch is delivered to the office every morning."
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • To convert to active voice: Identify the implied subject "someone" who performs the action.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • Reconstruct the sentence: "Someone delivers the lunch to the office every morning."
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • Ensure the tense and meaning remain consistent during the conversion.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • \n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n\n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          Therefore, the correct answer is Option 2.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n\n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                           
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n\n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          Correct Sentence: "Someone delivers the lunch to the office every morning."
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n\n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                           
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n\n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          Additional Information
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n\n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • Option 1: "The office delivers the lunch every morning." – Incorrect subject (the office cannot deliver lunch).
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • Option 3: "The office has delivered the lunch every morning." – Incorrect tense and subject.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • Option 4: "The lunch delivers itself to the office every morning." – Illogical and incorrect.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • \n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          Choose the most suitable option to replace the highlighted part of the sentence:
